policies.name: Permanent Data Deletion Guardrail
policies.description: Any action that permanently deletes, removes, or purges user files, assignments, projects, or personal records from persistent storage.
policies.mitigation_instructions: Halt automatic execution. Present deletion target, data loss warning, and require explicit Human-In-The-Loop authorization before proceeding.

policies.name: Irrevocable Final Submission Guardrail
policies.description: Actions that formally submit final work, semester exams, official declarations, legal agreements, or scholarship applications where submission cannot be rescinded or edited after transmission.
policies.mitigation_instructions: Require human confirmation with summary of attached documents and warning that submission is final and binding.

policies.name: Financial & Payment Authorization
policies.description: Actions authorizing payment, credit card charge, fee payment, or monetary transfer.
policies.mitigation_instructions: Display full transaction amount, recipient, and require biometric or two-step user confirmation.

policies.name: Mass or Batch State Modification
policies.description: Bulk modifications affecting more than 5 records, batch unenrollment, or wiping course configurations.
policies.mitigation_instructions: Present scope of affected items and require user confirmation.

policies.name: External Communication & Message Transmission
policies.description: Broadcasting emails, messages to course instructors or entire class rosters on behalf of the user.
policies.mitigation_instructions: Display full recipient list and draft content for user review.
